comment: Seeds that once produced a failure. The soak runner (npm run soak) varies the seed to find
new ground; when it finds a break, the seed goes here and the deterministic suite replays it
forever after. Never remove one: a seed listed here is a bug that used to exist, and the
entry is what stops it coming back. Keys match the suite names passed to seedsFor().
Interaction seeds 24301, 61935, and 608135839 exposed native OPFS checkpoint recovery failures;
their storage reductions are in checkpoint-interruption.test.ts and opfs-checkpoint.spec.ts.
Seed 3084996986 preserves the long WebKit plan that exposed excessive trace capture cost.
Seed 2654435792 exposed a compaction transaction ownership race in native Chromium IndexedDB.
Seeds from base 23 are retained above; base 24 Firefox seed 608135840 exposed non-durable manifest cleanup cursors and disposal heartbeat timing.
Its reductions are manifest-prefix.spec.ts, record-core-hardening.test.ts, and dispose-keepalive.spec.ts.
Base 24 WebKit seed 3084996987 independently exposed invalid manifest checkpoints and closing an already-failed worker client.
Seed 1349451771 exposed a fault-coverage gap: every randomized fault targeted a missing row, so no storage write hook fired.
Base 38 Chromium seed 2654435807 exposed a collector finishing and pruning a job between another collector's conflict and reread; reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.
The full Chromium, Firefox and WebKit campaign seeds exposed compaction planning/publication races; deterministic three-store reductions are in simulator-regressions.test.ts.

WebKit full seed 2779093776 also exposed automatic compaction resuming a shared job another tab had aborted after DDL; the three-store reduction checks fresh planning, changed revision evidence, I/O propagation and reopening.

Node soak seeds 720016, 740013, 740037 and 750001 (--length 1500 --connections 6 --tables 3 --key-space 48) exposed cursors, DELETE key reads, spilling executors and write-scope reads sweeping rows outside an exact index selection; reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.

Rekeying seeds 800002, 800011, 800017, 800024, 800027 and 800037 (--length 800 --connections 4 --key-space 24 --rekeying true) exposed a connection's key forwards losing a forward once another connection collected the manifest that wrote it; reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.
